blocks.text: IN THIS SCRIPT we will consider the many different facets of prophecy, healing, health and prosperity in which all these gifts are given for the elect of God’s benefit. — In one way or another at times they will see them work in their lives! — ‘‘First the gift of prophecy with its divers operations and its complex manifestations; and it is often hard to define because it can merge with the gift of knowledge, wisdom and the gift of interpretation! — It worked through prophets in the Old Testament to foretell events; and in the New Testament to edify, exhort and to foresee events. — In fact the book of Revelation is made up of future events of things to come!”’. . . ‘In the church, people can prophesy from time to time without the gift of prophecy, and yet there is a gift of prophecy that generally surrounds a prophet!’’ — ‘‘The gift of prophecy can be a carrier of other gifts as we have briefly described. — Also prophecy is one of the best gifts. (I Cor. 14:5)... Inthe Old Testament days people inquired of the Lord through a priest or a prophet — and in this present dispensation all believers are a part of the royal priesthood, and we are encouraged to seek the gifts!’’ (I Peter 2:9) . . . ‘“We don’t have space to do a study on all the gifts, but some of the operations of certain gifts so resemble each other, that they appear to merge one into the other as the colors of a rainbow!”’ . . . ‘‘In my own life the three power gifts of faith, healing and miracles merge together and manifest often in one service — and often the three revelatory gifts merge together as well as the other gifts! Because of this experience I am able to explain many of the revelation mysteries to the people both in writing and in speaking, and to foretell events! — But now let’s get back to the instructions and teachings of the Holy Spirit concerning the saints!’

“WE WILL LIST SOME PURPOSES concerning the gift of prophecy. One is for exhortation to awaken the people, as Jesus did in Rey. 2:4-5. It is given for comfort!’’ (II Cor. 1:4) — ‘‘The gift brings conviction to the sinner!’’ (I Cor. 14:24-25).. . “Tt was used for blessings in the Old Testament! (Heb. 11:20-21) — There is prophecy in song, as the Psalms of David and song of Deborah and Barak!’ — (Judges 5) ‘Prophecy is for edification! (Ps. chap. 1) — Messianic prophecy, prophecies of judgment, prophecies of lamentation such as Jeremiah!’’. . . ‘‘Then you have apocalyptic prophecies and of course revelatory prophecies that can be found in the book of Daniel or the apocalypse of the book of Revelation! Revelation is a book of prophecy!’’ (Rev. 22:1-3, 10)

THE GIFT OF PROPHECY CAN PREDICT economic conditions to warn the people, and of famine and droughts. (II Kings 7:1-2,16-20 — Rev. 6:6 — Rev. 11:6) — ‘‘Prophecy forewarns of judgment to come!’’ (Rev. 18:8). . . “Prophecy can foretell the coming and goings of kings and presidents as it occurred in the Old Testament times! — The name of king Cyrus was given before he was born and so was Solomon!’’ . . . ‘‘Prophecy foresees events hundreds and thousands of years in advance often times! . . . As Daniel foresaw the wicked king, the anti-christ, 2,500 years in advance!’’ (Dan. 8:23-26) ‘‘He also foresaw the last wicked empire on earth, as did John!”’ (Rev. 13) — ‘‘As we know Jesus with John on the Isle of Patmos gave the very Capstone of all prophecy! . . . A major prophet lives in a dimension and magnitude unknown to most people! — That is why prophets are rejected and hard to understand! — They do not line up with the masses and the systems, but with the word of God!’’

IIT PETER 1:19, WE HAVE ALSO A MORE SURE WORD OF PROPHECY; “‘whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the ‘day star’ arise in your hearts. ’’ — Verse 21, “‘also says, prophecy does not come by the will of man, but by the Holy Spirit!’’ — “‘The Scriptures above mean at the end of the age prophecy will be made plainer with more understanding that will warn and guide the elect of Jesus’ soon return!’’ — “The day star will rest over the prophet and the elect as the age closes!’’ — ‘‘The Bright and Morning Star will give the bride so much light, that she eventually goes away in this light of the Holy Spirit!’’

TO UNDERSTAND THE FULL DEPTHS OF THE GIFT OF PROPHECY— “‘let us consider Enoch’s brief prophecy... We have about ten main elements which are involved in true prophecy! — Read Jude 1:14-15.’’ — ‘‘First it says Enoch was the 7th from Adam indicating that he was a prophet that reached spiritual perfection! — And as we know he was translated! . .. God sets prophets in positions and not by man! — Next the prophecy pointed towards Christ! — The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy!’’ (Rev. 19:10) — ‘In one way or another all prophecy points towards the return of Jesus!’’ — ‘‘Behold the Lord cometh with ten thousand of His saints!’’ — “‘If He comes with them, then we know He must have already come for them! — This speaks of the translation before the last 42 months of the Tribulation!’’ — ‘‘The number 10 is involved, meaning completion or the beginning of a new era or series! — In Enoch’s prophecy he warned the ungodly to awaken them. And then, too, he predicted judgment!’”’? — ‘‘Behold the Lord cometh to execute judgment on all!’? — ‘‘Often the prophet himself is allowed to act out in a drama! — Such as John on the Isle of Patmos was caught up in translation!”’ Rev. chap. 4 — ‘“‘In the case of Elijah and Enoch, they were translated to become a type of these who should not see death, but who would be raptured in ectasy!”’ (I Thess. 4:13-17) — ‘‘At the end of the age prophecy will forewarn the elect and to reveal to them the season of the coming of the Lord; but evidently not the exact day or the hour!’’ — (I Thess. 5:1,4-6) . . . ‘‘This subject concerning prophecy is immense and it would take a whole book to reveal it all, but I touched on some important factors for your benefit!’’

NOW LET’S SAY A FEW WORDS about health, healing and prosperity! — In Ps. 103:2, ‘‘it commands us not to forget ALL of God’s benefits! — He forgives ALL sins! — And heals ALL diseases. Wonders!”’ . . . Verse 4, ‘‘reveals who protects you through your life, who overshadows you in loving kindness that you are to yield to!”’ ... Verse 5, ‘‘will lead you to eat the best foods for you. — He will renew your youth and will give you divine energy and strength by this youth!’’ — ‘‘Who satisfies thy mouth with good things means more than just food! — For man shall not live by bread alone! — Because health is in the anointing and word! — For they are life and health to you! (Prov. 4:20-22)... Prov. 17:22, ‘‘A merry heart doeth good like a medicine, but a broken spirit drieth the bones!’’ . . . “The anointed word can be used as a medicine! — Some people take medicine 3 times a day, but if they would take the word of God three times a day they would bring health to their flesh! — So that thy youth is renewed like the eagles! (Verse 5) — Amazing truths; Activate them!’

III JOHN 1:2 REVEALS THE CAPSTONE OF HEALTH AND PROSPERITY.— “‘Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth. Revealing you are not limited, but can have all that you can believe for!’ — “Now the secrets of Abraham’s prosperity were given by revelation in the Old Testament. — Each step revealed to us the way of God’s prosperity and will! — But first let’s take some advice from Jesus! — God’s people are to have possessions, but these possessions are not to possess them! — They are to be good stewards, then they will be given more as they give! — This thought is clearly expressed by Jesus. — If a man puts Him first, then Jesus will put him first!’’ — “Seek ye the kingdom of God and all of these things will be added unto you!” (Matt. 6:33) “Then Jesus will meet a person’s needs and give him an abundance of blessings in due time!’’

NOW ABRAHAM’S REVELATION SECRETS TO PROSPERITY— ‘He met the supreme test of obeying God, even if it cost him everything!’’ (Gen. 22:16-18) — ‘‘When he obeyed the Lord concerning his son, the Lord said, ‘by myself I have sworn,’ saith the Lord, ‘because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thine only son, that in blessing I will bless thee.” Because Abraham had obeyed, God promised him the very gates of the earth, that his seed would be as the stars in heaven in multitude! — By giving all, Abraham had gained all! — By seeking spiritual things, he received temperal things!’? — ‘‘Jesus referred to this ‘hundred fold’ blessing!’’ (St. Mark 10:29-31) — ‘‘And what Jesus said will parallel Abraham’s revelation to us about prosperity! — You can find these truths in Gen chaps. 12:1 thru chap. 14 and Gen. 22, Abraham’s supreme test!”’

NOW NEXT— “‘Abraham forsook all to obey God — without question! — He refused to turn back in the midst of tests! — He did not seek wealth with sharp practices, but used faith and wisdom as Jacob was to learn later in life! — He refused the wealth of Sodom. (Gen. 14:23) They could not buy him as they did Lot for a time!’” — ‘‘Abraham let God bless him by giving!’’ — ‘‘He was generous, prudent and honest. He believed in working, and by faith, for what he received! — But the outstanding thing of his life was he met the supreme test in obeying God about his son! — In his heart by faith, he knew the Lord would provide a better way even if He had to raise him to life again!” — ‘In obeying, he gained all!’ — ‘‘Sometimes in the very last moment of a test God pours out a great blessing!’’

ABRAHAM GIVES OFFERINGS AND TITHES (Gen. 14:18-24)— Gen. 13:2, “says Abraham was very rich in cattle, in silver and in gold.’ (Gen. 24:35) — “‘And as the age closes the Lord will bring health and prosperity and will spread a cloud of light over thee for protection and guidance!’ (Ps. 105:37-43) — “‘He will bless us until our work is finished in the harvest!’’ — “My prayer for my partners is that they will receive the manyfold blessings of the Lord in the days ahead as they rejoice in helping in this work!”

HERE ARE SOME SCRIPTURES for your encouragement! — ‘‘My God shall supply all your needs!”’ (Phil. 4:19) . . . ‘“Thou shalt make thy way prosperous and thou shalt have good success!’? (Josh. 1:8) . . . ‘‘But remember give, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven!’’ (Matt. 19:21) — Prov. 10:22 . . . “Giving assures good measure in return from Jesus who wills that you prosper!’ (III John 1:2)... Together let’s take the gospel to the utmost parts of the earth! Acts 1:8.
